title: DEBT76: the walk's card sheet on a phone sells, and no running check proves it
note: On a phone, a tap on a walk row opens the card in a sheet. The sheet draws `Orders.OrderPickPane`, the same pane the desk draws. That pane passes `detail` to `CardHero.CardPane`. `detail` holds the copy rows, and each row carries `OrdersWalkPane.RowAction`, so Mark sold is in the sheet. The gap this entry first recorded, a sheet with no Mark sold, is fixed in code. Action line: step audit-1-1. The to-do audit says close it.
